card.name: Linking words in all-caps headlines and warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, to, will, not, please) inside all-caps headlines or capitalized warning text, just before a verb. Also scattered odd spots such as a space before a section number.

modes.label: All-caps headline
modes.description: A small joining word in a capitalized title, right before a verb like go or fish.
modes.example: HAIKU RULES THAT HAVE COME<< AND>> GONE Take Your Pick Ha

modes.label: All-caps instruction
modes.description: A modal or negation word in a capitalized instruction about how something should be done.
modes.example: SHOULD BE MADE SLOWLY AND WITH REPEATED ASPIRATION. CARE SHOULD BE TAKEN TO DETERMINE THAT ANY INJECTION<< WILL>> NOT BE INTRA-ARTERIAL

modes.label: Stray spots
modes.description: A space or a letter in the middle of a word, in label text near section numbers.
modes.example: Discontinuation Syndrome: Taper dose when possible and monitor for discontinuation symptoms (<< >>5.7 ). Seizure:

card.writes: It pushes the output toward forms of go (going, goes, went), which fits a verb of motion after come and.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in shouted capital-letter headlines and warnings, where a form of go might come next.
